org.portico.lrc.services.mom.data

Class MomFederation

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.services.mom.data.MomFederation

  • public class MomFederation
extends Object
    Contains links between the OCInstance used to represent the federation in the federation and the Federation management object that holds all the information. This class also serializes the information for updates when they are requested.
